reported.title: Motor never starts when level begins at or above 25 cm
reported.description: The only path into ST_RUN is the FILL branch at lines 77-80, and FILL is only entered from IDLE when levelCm < EMPTY_CM (10 cm) at lines 73-76. If the probe already reads at or above 25 cm while in IDLE, no branch fires, so state stays ST_IDLE and driveOutputs() at line 38 keeps D10 LOW; the engine measured D10 not HIGH for 4400 ms starting at 600 ms in the out-of-range high-level scenario and for 3400 ms starting at 600 ms in the max/min range scenario. D10 was in the wrong state for 3550 ms across 1 interval(s), first at 2.53 s: D10 was not HIGH for 3550 ms while required (grace 600 ms).

judge_input.spec:
- Level probe on A0 at 10 mV/cm; fill valve on D9; drum motor on D10; reset on D4 (pull-up).
- States: IDLE (both outputs OFF), FILL (valve D9 HIGH until level >= 25.0 cm), RUN (motor D10 HIGH while level stays >= 20.0 cm), then IDLE.
- Leave RUN and return to IDLE when level drops below 20.0 cm; motor D10 must go LOW within 600 ms.
- Enter FILL from IDLE when level is below 10.0 cm.
- Holding D4 LOW forces IDLE immediately.
- Print `laundry st=<0|1|2> cm=<n>` every 1000 ms.
